Risk description: No real sponsor or data owner to validate requirements
Mitigation / contingency: Label assumptions; define validation questions; require sponsor sign-off before real deployment

Risk description: Synthetic datasets underrepresent production edge cases
Mitigation / contingency: Document sample limits; add representative anonymized test cases only with authorization

Risk description: CI success is misinterpreted as production readiness
Mitigation / contingency: State CI scope and production exclusions in README and closure report

Risk description: Timezone assumptions cause incorrect historical timestamps
Mitigation / contingency: Require source timezone contract; test offsets and daylight-saving transitions before real use

Risk description: Duplicate handling may not match business survivorship rules
Mitigation / contingency: Require data-owner-approved survivorship rules and reconciliation report

Risk description: Foreign-key or load-order failures block authorization migration
Mitigation / contingency: Load in dependency order; verify FK constraints in MySQL integration CI

Risk description: Artifact retention or CI platform changes reduce evidence availability
Mitigation / contingency: Keep durable reports in repository; periodically verify workflow links

Risk description: Unrecorded historical estimates or costs lead to false performance claims
Mitigation / contingency: Use relative planning estimates; do not calculate SPI CPI or velocity without baseline and actuals

Risk description: Scope expands into production security and operations without resources
Mitigation / contingency: Use change control; defer production requirements to a separately authorized project
